capabilities.description: Metadata provider for manga items. Primary source MangaBaka (aggregating AniList, MyAnimeList, MangaUpdates, Kitsu, Anime-Planet, Shikimori) with a MangaDex deep fallback and AniList banner backdrops.

global_config_schema.title: Enabled sources
global_config_schema.description: Comma-separated source IDs to search (mangabaka, mangadex). Empty uses the default set.

global_config_schema.title: Use local MangaBaka dump
global_config_schema.description: Download MangaBaka's database (~335MB, ~1.5GB on disk) for offline, rate-limit-free matching. Recommended for large libraries. Default off.

global_config_schema.title: Dump storage path
global_config_schema.description: Override where the dump is stored. Default: OS cache dir. Point at a roomy volume if needed.

global_config_schema.title: Dump refresh interval (hours)
global_config_schema.description: How often to re-download the dump. Default 168 (weekly).

global_config_schema.title: AniList banner backdrops
global_config_schema.description: MangaBaka has no banner art. When on, fetch a hero backdrop from AniList by id for matched series. Default on.
